name: trash
description: A straight-sided waste bin with rounded base corners, an open handle and two internal slots. Solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested straight sides and rounded corners. The bucket now has vertical centerlines at x=6 and x=18, from y=6 to17.9, with the standard Camera/Folder radius-3.25 bottom corners and bottom centerline y=21.15. Filled uses the exact .85 outward offset, with radius-4.10 exterior bottom corners. The fitted small handle uses radius-1 centerline corners, top centerline y=2.85, and corresponding radius-1.85 outer/.15 inner Filled corners. The level lid runs x=4..20 at y=6 with round .85 caps. Overall visible bounds x=3.15..20.85 and y=2..22 give the vertical primary pair exact 2px margins, with balanced 3.15px left/right. Two vertical slots retain their round ends at x=10,14 and y=10..17; Filled counters align with the Outline strokes. No enclosing box is added to Trash. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70. The owner approved both styles, including the fitted small handle corners, on 2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner accepted the current Trash in both styles, including straight sides, radius-3.25 centerline base corners, fitted radius-1 handle corners and 2px top/bottom primary margins.
